findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mesloisirs_search_experiences, mesloisirs_get_destination, mesloisirs_get_experience · Public sink: mesloisirs_search_experiences, mesloisirs_get_destination, mesloisirs_get_experience.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mesloisirs_search_experiences, mesloisirs_get_destination, mesloisirs_get_experience · Public sink: mesloisirs_search_experiences, mesloisirs_get_destination, mesloisirs_get_experience

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
